services.value: Provides drug development and toxicology CRO services, including mammalian, aquatic, avian, insect, plant, microbial, and biodegradation studies, plus whole effluent toxicity (WET) testing for permit-regulated clients. Also offers analytical chemistry services (physical/chemical property testing and HPLC/IC/LCMS/GC-FID/GC-MS) and compliant testing under EPA and FDA GLPs and EPA and OECD Guidelines.
